identified_as: Duquesne High School, Duquesne, Allegheny Co.
era: High school closed in 2007; students go to West Mifflin Area / East Allegheny
notes: 'Dukes' confirmed by the 1942 Echo yearbook (football and basketball 'the Dukes'). Colours: a closing-of-the-school newspaper article reposted on duquesnehunky.com opens 'Farewell faithful followers of the red and white!'; 1942 Echo: tennis team in 'red shorts with white shirts', safety-squad pin red and white. An alumni comment likens the football uniforms to the San Francisco 49ers (red and gold), so gold trim is possible but unconfirmed. Echo class colours (1942 Ivory and Scarlet, 1943 Marine Blue and Silver) are class colours, not school colours. Not Duquesne University (red and blue).
